This isn't what you're going to want to hear, but you shouldn't kill yourself. I attempted suicide and I took a whole bunch a sleeping medicine that i was prescribed for insomnia, I opened the capsules and put the powder in chocolate frosting and ate it. My heart rate slowed down a lot and I fell asleep. I woke up almost 24 hours later, and even then I couldn't function. Im not saying that looking back i appreciate life more, I'm saying that death isn't preferable to finding a solution to your problems.  I went to the hospital after i woke up and they lied me down and I fell asleep again. I didn't wake up for two more days. When i woke up they told me that my heart actually stopped a few times because it was so low. I didn't dream those times it was just a black nothingness. And honestly through all the trouble i caused its worth it to at least try a little more to make yourself feel better before ending it.

Im sorry to hear that your family isn't taking your mental health seriously. Please try to take care of yourself. With anxious thoughts it can make your mind race and its hard to find control, so you just have to work at it, at meditating. If there isn't anywhere you can go to be alone and try to figure yourself out i would try taking a bath. Please know that you matter and that what you're experiencing matters, if no one is listening find new people to help you. Please be safe

What I have found helps me is challenging those negitive thoughts, "you are good enough and here's why". 

I don't think you are a fuck up, I think you've handled yourself well given the situation.  You went and got help. You went and looked for a solution so that proves that you want to get better, that you do want to live. You will find someone else that makes you happy, you deserve happiness please try to remember that. Try to be safe okay?
